subject: Sunset governance: customer notice draft + exceptions runway
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sunset governance: customer notice draft + exceptions runway

Team —

We’ve been asked by Product to finalize the public notice and exception process for the upcoming model family sunset (target cutover window July 20-26). High-level asks:

- Approve customer notice language for BlueWave and 2 other enterprise pilots. Draft attached (sunset-notice-v1.docx).
- Confirm exception runway: who can approve a 90-day compatibility extension and what telemetry we need to gate it.
- Decide on a single inbox and triage flow for security/compliance inquiries during the migration window.

Notes: BlueWave is in the middle of procurement and has a SOC2 audit in June — they need an explicit fallback path and a named point of contact. I’d like to get alignment internally by EOD Monday so we can send the notice Tuesday.

Please reply with approvals or edits inline. If you need a short call, propose 30m slots Monday morning.

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sunset-notice-v1.docx (docx, 18KB); exception-request-template.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sunset governance: customer notice draft + exceptions runway

Vivek —

Read the draft. Overall strong; two quick edits I suggest:

1) Replace the phrase "will be deprecated" with "will transition to a supported variant" in the first paragraph — less alarming for customers in procurement.
2) Add a one-line FAQ about what happens to pinned model versions in Dedicated.

On exceptions: I’m OK with a 90-day extension for customers with active procurement or certified audits, provided we require a justification (impact, rollback plan) and agree to a weekly sync until the extension ends. Approver list: Laura (Product), Ben (Sales), and an ops sign-off from Priyom for capacity. If any exception looks like it could materially affect SLOs, escalate to Marissa.

Approve sending Tuesday with my edits applied.

- Laura
Director, Product
Redwood Inference

Folks —

Operational checklist and gating telemetry I propose:

- Required telemetry for exception approval: active usage rate (last 30d), percent of traffic pinned to deprecated model, error-rate delta for pinned traffic, and a migration test run result from the customer (if available).
- Capacity impact: if exceptions exceed 3 concurrent enterprise 90-day extensions in a region, we throttle new exceptions until we have runway.
- Triage inbox: sunsetting-ops@redwood.com (Priyom will own initial triage; Marissa will take escalations).

I’ve attached an exception-request-template.xlsx to standardize submissions. Approvals will be recorded in HS-123456 in HubSpot for audit.

Priyom
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Notice: upcoming model family transition — targeted July 20-26 (BlueWave)

Rika / BlueWave team —

Thanks for the procurement conversation last week. We want to give you a heads-up that a family of older model variants will transition to supported variants during the July 20-26 window. We do not expect feature regressions for the supported variants, but as a precaution we’re offering:

- Dedicated migration help: two 1:1 office hours with our solution engineers, and one migration dry-run in a sandbox.
- If you need a temporary compatibility extension (up to 90 days) while you complete audit/procurement, please use the attached exception template and email sunsetting-ops@redwood.com. Priyom will triage and confirm next steps within 3 business days.

We’re attaching a short FAQ and the exception template. If you prefer, we can push the notice to a later date — tell us your preferred timeline by EOD Wednesday.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sunset-notice-v1.docx; exception-request-template.xlsx

From: Rika Kobayashi <rkobayashi@enterpriseops.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueWave Health <security@bluewavehealth.com>, contracts@bluewavehealth.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: upcoming model family transition — targeted July 20-26 (BlueWave)

Hi Vivek —

Appreciate the heads-up and the migration offer. A couple of asks from our side:

1) Can BlueWave get a written commitment that pinned model optics (logs, KV caches) will be retained for 120 days post-transition for audit purposes?
2) We’ll need a one-page note for our SOC2 auditor explaining the rollback and data-retention policy for the deprecated variants.

We’ll aim to submit the exception template by Friday, but we need the retention confirmation to be explicit before we proceed with procurement.

Thanks,
Rika Kobayashi
Procurement Lead, Enterprise Ops
BlueWave Health

Short answers:

- Retention: we can commit to retaining pinned model request/response logs and KV cache snapshot artifacts for 120 days post-transition for audit purposes. We’ll record the retention scope in the exception approval record and provide the one-page auditor note.
- Process: please send the filled exception-request-template to sunsetting-ops@redwood.com. Priyom will triage and confirm within 3 business days; Ben and Laura will review approvals within 48 hours of triage if it looks like a procurement-related ask.

I’ll upload the auditor note template to the Drive link (HS-123456) and share when ready. If your legal team needs an explicit SLA addendum, let me know and we’ll scope it with Legal.

Thanks — we’ll keep the line open and prioritize BlueWave.

Vivek

Redwood Inference
